Odh tujhi laaga, man maaga maaga bhaaga,
Ichaar kaay tyaacha kalana.

I don’t understand what this heart is thinking anymore.

Jeena gela jhuranyata, tujhya maaga maaga palanyata, daav mala purata kalana. 

My whole life has been spent longing for you,
Running behind you, chasing after you.
I just can’t figure out this game of love.

⸻

PRE-CHORUS

Kiti dis challay, khel hyo manacha?
Thamb mhan tyala aata!!

How many more days will this heart keep playing this game?
 tell it to, “Stop now…”

Ye ki tu ga gaata gaata 

The Halgi beats inside my heart,
Come to me, singing your way into my life.

⸻

Kaalij dhad dhada, dhada,
Naadach laaglay ga. 

My heart keeps pounding, pounding,
I’m completely lost in the rhythm of you.

Samdikada hoti Gadbada,
Bhanach gelay ga. 

Everything around me feels restless and chaotic,
I’ve completely lost myself.

⸻

VERSE 2
Yeda jhala tujhyapaayi jeev saara,
Tujhya bhovati jag phirtay. 

I’ve gone crazy because of you,
My whole world revolves around you.

Aapsuk tujhyach naadana byena,
Din raat ek kartay. 

Without even realizing it, I’ve become lost in your rhythm,
Turning day and night into one, just thinking of you.

Ikada- tikada tu jail jail jikada,
Pathalaag kartay. 

Wherever you go, wherever you wander,
My heart keeps following you.

Hur hur jeevala phukatchi majhya,
Mala samda kaltay. 

This restless longing in me is pointless,
 I understand everything what you’re doing to me. 

⸻

PRE-CHORUS 2
Tujhi mi kahani, lhivhayala ghetli,
Jhali tyachi premgatha. 

I began writing your story,
And somehow, it became a love novel of its own.

Halgi vaaja kaaljaat majhya,
Ye ki tu ga gaata gaata. 

The Halgi beats inside my heart,
Come to me, singing your way into my life.

⸻

CHORUS
Kaalij dhad dhada, dhad dhada
Naadach laaglay ga. 

My heart keeps pounding, pounding,
I’m completely lost in the rhythm of you.

Samdikada hoti gadbada,
Bhanach gelay ga. 

Everything around me feels restless and chaotic,
I’ve completely lost myself.
